scene.description_zh: 工业桌面俯视/斜视固定相机。桌上有一根竖直立着的金属圆柱零件，右侧有分格料箱（可见第2排第3格），背景墙面与桌面纹理保持固定。画面中有一只 Franka Panda 机械臂与平行夹爪，初始夹爪张开，位于零件上方附近。
scene.camera: fixed third-person industrial RGB, no camera motion

objects.cylinder: upright metal cylinder on table, graspable
objects.bin: partitioned bin with visible row2-col3 cell
objects.arm: Franka Panda with two-finger gripper, initially open

scene.notes: All paired variants under one case MUST share this exact initial frame.

requests.prompt: Predict the future video if the robot holds still with gripper open.
